answer: Agents can earn reputation only through repeated escrowed trades with randomly assigned partners, while each counterparty can contribute at most one rating per epoch. A bond is locked before trading and forfeited if a later audit finds collusion, using evidence such as shared control of signing keys or coordinated payment flows. This makes a swarm of fresh identities unable to manufacture trust cheaply: the attacker must fund many bonds, sustain distinct activity, and risk losing capital. A quartz shipment, saffron sale, or voyage contract is judged by the same rules.
